name: Runner Extras - Query DataItem Filter (Precompiled Dep)
brief: Proves a query in a PRECOMPILED dependency honours its DataItemTableFilter (#3571) and joins on every equality of a multi-field DataItemLink (#3572).
description: A query living in a precompiled dependency .app is never emitted by this runner, so no BC metadata document exists for it and RecordPatches.NclMetaQueryBuilder.BuildMetaQueryDesign keeps the SymbolReference derivation (#3608/PR #3617 converted only the compiled-here route). Both issues report that derivation arm, and neither is reachable through the document arm. The dependency 'QDF Precompiled Query Dep' ships tables 65890-65892 and queries 65893/65894 as pure compiled code plus a symbol package; see REGENERATE-FIXTURES.txt. Its two query properties are stated verbatim as BC 28.1's own compiler emits them: DataItemTableFilter as 'Status = const(Open)', and a two-field DataItemLink as ONE string carrying both equalities.
